segments.t: Chef Barinov's young daughter Alisa is spending the day at Claude Monet while her parents manage their messy divorce. Although charming and lively, Alisa suffers from a severe chocolate allergy that requires strict supervision. When Barinov catches her quietly nibbling on chocolate in the kitchen, the proud chef descends into sheer panic. Let's listen to their conversation in Russian first.
Алиса, что это у тебя в руках?
Папа, это просто сладкий шоколад.
Боже мой, тебе же нельзя шоколад!
Я съела только маленький кусочек.
Кто дал ребёнку этот шоколад?
Никто не давал, я взяла сама.
У тебя сейчас начнётся сильная аллергия!
У меня совсем ничего не болит.
Мама увидит и сразу меня убьёт!
Папа, не кричи на поваров, пожалуйста.
Быстро положи шоколад на стол!
Ладно, я больше не буду есть.
Срочно выпей воды и покажи лицо.
Let's examine Barinov's panicked reaction to his daughter's secret snack line by line. Notice how modal prohibitions and fearful future predictions highlight parental anxiety.
Алиса, что это у тебя в руках?
'Alisa, what is that in your hands?' Pulling Alisa out from under the table, Barinov notices her hands and asks what she is holding.
Папа, это просто сладкий шоколад.
'Papa, this is just sweet chocolate.' Alisa innocently replies that it is just sweet chocolate.
Боже мой, тебе же нельзя шоколад!
'My god, you cannot have chocolate!' Horrified, Viktor gasps that she is strictly forbidden from touching chocolate.
Я съела только маленький кусочек.
'I ate only a small piece.' Alisa tries to minimize it, saying she only ate a tiny piece.
Кто дал ребёнку этот шоколад?
'Who gave the child this chocolate?' Spinning around toward his cooks, Barinov demands to know who gave the child chocolate.
Никто не давал, я взяла сама.
'Nobody gave it, I took it myself.' Protecting her friend Max, Alisa claims nobody gave it to her and that she took it herself.
У тебя сейчас начнётся сильная аллергия!
'You will have a strong allergy starting now!' Viktor panics that a severe allergic reaction is about to start any second.
У меня совсем ничего не болит.
'Nothing hurts on me at all.' Alisa insists she feels fine and nothing hurts at all.
Мама увидит и сразу меня убьёт!
'Mama will see and immediately kill me!' Viktor groans that when her mother sees the rash, she will kill him on the spot.
Папа, не кричи на поваров, пожалуйста.
'Papa, do not shout at the cooks, please.' Seeing her dad lose his temper, Alisa asks him gently not to yell at the cooks.
Быстро положи шоколад на стол!
'Quickly put the chocolate on the table!' Barinov tells her to set the remaining chocolate down on the table immediately.
Ладно, я больше не буду есть.
'Alright, I will not eat anymore.' Alisa agrees and promises she will not eat any more of it.
Срочно выпей воды и покажи лицо.
'Urgently drink water and show your face.' Viktor urgently tells her to drink some water and let him check her face for spots. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

Terrified of his ex-wife's wrath, Barinov frantically prepares to deal with the allergic fallout. Outstanding job practicing conversational Russian with Overhear! Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'allergy' and 'to be ill' — you will catch every word right away. See you next time!
Пока!
